title: Phone text-field zoom rule: follow-ups from the RF-196 review
acceptance: A decision is recorded on targeting iOS WebKit directly (for example @supports (-webkit-touch-callout: none)) instead of viewport size and pointer type, weighing that Chromium e2e cannot exercise an iOS-only guard.
The landscape zoom check covers Music › Songs search and the Create a class sheet, not only sign-up, or the record says why not.
The media query lives in one place that index.css and e2e/smoke.spec.ts both read, or a check fails when the two copies differ.
nextAction: Logged from the fresh-context review of the RF-196 PR (2026-11-05 unattended Neo session). Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.
